# 🧠 VyaparIQ

> **An AI-powered CRM platform built for Indian MSMEs.**
> Manage customers, track business performance, and unlock intelligent insights — all in one place.

VyaparIQ is an open-source data intelligence platform that takes raw CSV, Excel, or PDF files and automatically generates beautiful, interactive dashboards with KPIs, charts, trend analysis, correlation heatmaps, and strategic insights — all powered by AI.

---

## ✨ Features

- **📂 Multi-format Upload** — Drag & drop CSV, Excel (.xlsx/.xls), or PDF files
- **🤖 AI-Powered Analysis** — Automatic data cleaning, type detection, outlier flagging, and insight generation
- **📊 Smart Visualizations** — Auto-generated charts (Line, Bar, Area, Pie, Scatter, Histogram, Stacked, Horizontal Bar)
- **📈 KPI Cards** — Dynamically computed metrics with intelligent aggregation
- **🔍 Correlation Analysis** — Interactive heatmap showing relationships between numeric columns
- **📉 Trend Analysis** — Time-series decomposition with moving averages
- **🎯 Filter & Slice** — Dynamic filters with AI-suggested presets
- **💡 Strategic Insights** — AI-generated actionable recommendations
- **🌙 Dark Mode UI** — Premium glassmorphic dark theme
- **⚡ Real-time Streaming** — Watch the AI think and build your dashboard live

---

## 🚀 Quick Start

### Prerequisites

- [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/) (v18 or higher)
- [OpenRouter API Key](https://openrouter.ai/keys) (free tier available)

### Setup

1. **Clone or download this repository**

   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/VyaparIQ.git
   cd VyaparIQ
   ```

2. **Install dependencies**

   ```bash
   npm install
   ```

3. **Set up your API key**

   Copy the example environment file and add your key:

   ```bash
   cp .env.example .env
   ```

   Open `.env` and replace the placeholder with your actual API key:

   ```env
   OPENROUTER_API_KEY="sk-or-v1-your-actual-key-here"
   ```

   > 💡 **Get a free API key:** Sign up at [openrouter.ai](https://openrouter.ai), go to [Keys](https://openrouter.ai/keys), and create one.

4. **Start the development server**

   ```bash
   npm run dev
   ```

5. **Open in your browser**

   Navigate to [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000)

## 🛠️ Tech Stack

| Technology | Purpose |
|---|---|
| **React 19** | UI framework |
| **TypeScript** | Type safety |
| **Vite** | Build tool & dev server |
| **Tailwind CSS v4** | Styling |
| **Recharts** | Chart visualizations |
| **D3.js** | Advanced data viz |
| **Motion (Framer)** | Animations |
| **PapaParse** | CSV parsing |
| **SheetJS (xlsx)** | Excel file parsing |
| **PDF.js** | PDF text extraction |
| **OpenRouter API** | AI model gateway (Gemini 2.5 Flash) |
| **Lucide React** | Icons |

---

## 📝 Available Scripts

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `npm run dev` | Start development server on port 3000 |
| `npm run build` | Build for production |
| `npm run preview` | Preview production build |
| `npm run lint` | Type-check with TypeScript |

---

## 🔑 API Configuration

This project uses [OpenRouter](https://openrouter.ai) as an AI gateway, specifically the **Gemini 2.5 Flash** model.

- **Free tier** includes generous usage limits
- No Google Cloud setup required
- API key is passed securely via environment variables

> ⚠️ **Important:** Never commit your `.env` file. The `.gitignore` is already configured to exclude it.
